prediction_text: Direction: he meets the friend - the visit succeeds. The friend is the one still stationary point in a wholly moving hexagram, so the meeting waits for that line's value day rather than happening at once. Timing: day-scale span (a visit in near days). Window: within the current jiachen xun; main coordinate the shen day (the sole still line, brother shen metal, meets its value). Confidence 0.60.
basis: Liuyao, visiting a friend - day of meeting: the friend is read from the brother lines. Brother appears twice: 3rd line bing-shen metal MOVING (changes to parent chou earth), and 5th line ren-shen metal STATIC at ying - and in this hexagram five of six lines move; the 5th line is the SOLE still line (du-jing), and it is exactly the friend's line at the ying (the other party's) position. Per the du-fa/du-jing rule (L1-15 and the Du-fa chapter this case comes from), the sole still line in a mass-moving hexagram fixes the timing coordinate and does not by itself decide direction: direction is decided on the routes - shen metal is xiang in wei month (four-season: metal xiang), the friend line is not empty (jiachen xun empties yin/mao - note the shi line's changed wife mao wood IS empty, a friction item) and not broken; the day wu fire cuts metal (a near-stage obstruction adjusting grade: the first days are blocked/delayed), but no line cuts the still brother line itself, and the mass movement around a still ying-brother reads as circumstances churning while the friend stays in place to be met. Donghua directions of the movers (recorded, none is the useful god): parent chen -> officer si; officer wu (shi) -> wife mao (empty change - the diviner's own errand leaks into emptiness in the near days, consistent with delay); brother shen (3rd) -> parent chou (hui-tou sheng of that mover); officer wu (4th) -> brother shen (changes INTO brother kin - a second brother presence appearing in the changes, supporting that the friend is reachable); parent xu -> offspring zi. Reverse conditions: none complete against the still useful god. Four routes: benqi +/0 (xiang, day-cut friction), yuan-ji-chou 0, donghua + (a change produces brother kin), shi-ying counted: ying is the friend line itself, already in route 1. Timing three steps: scale = day; candidates - chong-shi: yin day clashes shen, tian-shi: shen day fills the still line's own branch, feng-zhi: shen day value; du-jing rule takes the still line's value/fill point: shen day is both feng-zhi and tian-shi (same branch), a合流 of two mechanisms on one point; yin (clash) kept in reasoning - clashing a still, in-place friend line reads as disturbing rather than meeting him, rejected against the direction. Main coordinate: shen day, single.
